paragraphs.text: The Faerie nobles are the leaders of the faeries of the Great Wood on Ulgrotha.

Autumn Willow created one of them, Devin , in the likeness of Veldrane of Sengir . The nobles and their faeries took over the River Bridge in the Great Wood and would push away anyone the Autumn Willow did not want to cross into the waters to their deaths. While most of the faerie folk spend their time playing pranks upon one another, the faerie nobles brood over the safety of their subjects. In times of war, they will lead the faeries into battle; in times of peace, they will act as ambassadors and diplomats. Philosophy amongst madness is a hard thing to find, but the faerie nobles are wise in the ways of the humans of An-Havva and their own people.
